entries.title: Urbek City Builder
entries.definitive_edition: Urbek City Builder on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Urbek City Builder launched on Windows PC before later Xbox, Switch, and PlayStation releases. The native PC version is the highest-fidelity route and there is no exclusive console gameplay content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release on Steam.

all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity route and no sourced exclusive content elsewhere.
skip: no exclusive content; use Windows PC for the primary route.

all_releases.fidelity: Xbox Series X/S release with 4K, HDR10, Smart Delivery, and Series optimization.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console version, but no exclusive content over PC.
skip: portable option, but no exclusive content over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: PlayStation 4 release; it can be played on PS5 via compatibility.
all_releases.reason: skip: no exclusive content and not a separate native PS5 release in the public store listing.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform-exclusive gameplay content was found; Windows PC remains the highest-fidelity complete route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or definitive gameplay edition was found. The PlayStation listing is a PS4 product playable on PS5, not a separately sourced native PS5 edition.
